title: Full-text and trigram search over millions of documents under tenant RLS
issue: tsvector @@ and ILIKE/pg_trgm are not leakproof (checked on PG18 in the README), so with RLS the planner may not use them as index conditions before the policy qual runs; the policy's tenant filter drives the plan and the search operator filters rows one by one.
symptom: Searches that are a fast GIN bitmap scan without RLS become a scan of every row of the subject's tenants for broad subjects; selective subjects stay fast because their tenant set is small.

scale.meaning: rows in app.documents (1.1 GB heap, 371 MB of indexes at 2M). Tenants = scale/2000, uniform. Words follow a skewed distribution over 100000 terms: term0 is in ~35% of documents, term99998 in a handful.

subjects.name: selective
subjects.note: member of one tenant (~2000 docs at 2M)

subjects.name: many
subjects.note: member of 2/3 of all tenants (667 of 1000 at default scale, so listed-ids plan)
